Scope1.1 This standard (Part 33) prescribes two P1ethods for determination of iodide namely (a) Spectrophotometric ethod, and (b) Vblumetric method in water and wastewaters.1.2 Volumetric method shall be followed as a referee method in case of difference of opinion.2.
